♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Capricorn in Shravana, your 10th house is under the lunar spotlight today, Aries. This is a very public, responsibility-heavy placement: how you handle duties and visibility matters. The Sun has just moved into sidereal Scorpio, energizing your 8th house, while Mercury and Mars travel together in Sagittarius in your 9th. There’s a strong push to turn intense inner questioning into a clearer sense of purpose and philosophy. You’re straddling the line between private transformation and outer achievement.

💼 Career: The Capricorn Moon in your 10th favors serious focus and measured moves. Superiors and clients may be less interested in your ideas and more interested in whether you deliver what you promised. Shravana’s listening quality helps you read the room—observe carefully before committing to a stance. With Mercury-Mars in your 9th, you can argue passionately for a belief, strategy or long-term plan, but avoid preaching. Use today to refine a proposal, policy, or course outline rather than forcing immediate buy-in.

❤️ Love: The Sun newly in your 8th house highlights emotional honesty, shared vulnerabilities and the parts of you that don’t show easily. You may notice where you keep some feelings under armor. The Moon at the top of your chart can make you more image-conscious; be careful not to perform confidence in love while hiding your softer needs. If partnered, a practical conversation about shared responsibilities can unexpectedly deepen intimacy. If single, you might feel drawn to people connected to your work or studies; check whether your attraction stems from genuine resonance or from admiring their status.

💰 Money: Scorpio’s 8th-house Sun continues to emphasize shared finances, insurance, taxes or business investments, but today’s Moon says: think about long-term stability, not quick maneuvers. Mars with Mercury in your 9th favors taking expert advice, studying a financial topic, or reviewing legal or contractual fine print around money. It’s a good day to set or adjust a savings goal tied to a major life direction—education, relocation, or a future venture—rather than chase short-term wins.

🧘 Advice: Lean into the grown-up part of you that can make calm decisions even when emotions run deep. Quiet conviction carries further than force today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Authority lands differently when it comes from having faced your own shadows, not from trying to outrun them.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Capricorn Moon moves through your 9th house today, Taurus, stirring a desire to make sense of things through learning, travel, or conversations with people who see the world differently. Your ruler Venus is still in Libra, strengthening your 6th house of routines and health, while the Sun has just entered Scorpio in your 7th, turning attention toward partners and key others. Mercury and Mars in Sagittarius light up your 8th house, making deeper questions about trust, intimacy and shared resources hard to ignore.

💼 Career: The 9th-house Moon supports activities that expand your professional horizon: training, policy review, working with foreign clients, or planning a future move or specialization. With Venus still steadying your 6th, small improvements to your schedule or workflow can have disproportionate benefits. Meanwhile, Mercury-Mars in the 8th favors digging into the numbers behind a project, grant, or joint venture. You can be persuasive today, but avoid pushing colleagues into uncomfortable transparency—lead by modeling your own clarity.

❤️ Love: The Scorpio Sun across from you in the 7th puts relationship dynamics under a magnifying glass. You may notice where a partnership feels intense but unclear, or where loyalty runs deep. The Capricorn Moon in your 9th can bring up questions about shared beliefs, ethics and long-term vision. If partnered, it’s a good day to talk through topics like relocation, education, spiritual paths or financial strategy with honesty and patience. If single, you might be attracted to someone slightly older, more experienced, or linked to education or travel; watch that you’re not just seeking a teacher figure.

💰 Money: With your 8th house activated by Mars and Mercury, topics like loans, debts, inheritances, or business funding are live. This is favorable for analysis, renegotiation and gathering documentation, but less ideal for large impulsive commitments. The 9th-house Moon suggests aligning any financial arrangements with your long-range worldview—are you agreeing to something that supports the life you actually want in ten years? A small step such as consolidating information or scheduling a professional consult can help.

🧘 Advice: Let curiosity, not fear, guide your exploration of serious topics. When you look unflinchingly at what you share with others, your choices get simpler.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The agreements that last are the ones that respect both your need for security and your need for growth.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: Today the Capricorn Moon moves through your 8th house, Gemini, bringing a more introspective, pragmatic approach to emotional entanglements and shared resources. Your ruler Mercury travels close to Mars in Sagittarius in your 7th house, intensifying one-to-one interactions. The Sun’s shift into sidereal Scorpio energizes your 6th house of work and health. This is a day where the deeper undercurrents behind everyday dealings are easier to feel and harder to ignore.

💼 Career: The Scorpio Sun in your 6th highlights problem-solving, systems and hidden inefficiencies. With the Moon in your 8th, issues around shared budgets, team accountability, or confidential matters could surface. Mercury-Mars in your 7th gives you sharp negotiation skills and courage to say what’s been unsaid with partners, clients or collaborators. Use that decisiveness to define roles, boundaries and expectations rather than to win arguments. Confidential reviews, contractual revisions or strategic planning sessions can be especially productive.

❤️ Love: Relationship energy is intense and candid. With your 7th house on fire from Mercury-Mars, conversations may quickly move to “What are we really doing here?” territory. The Capricorn Moon in the 8th steadies you enough to handle serious topics without melodrama, as long as you ground yourself before speaking. If partnered, this can be an excellent day to discuss joint priorities, past grievances, or sexual/emotional needs in a structured way. If single, strong attraction could arise with someone you meet through work or a negotiation; give it time before intertwining your lives.

💰 Money: The 8th-house Moon and Scorpio 6th emphasis both point to practical attention on finances—especially anything shared or complex. This might be audits, billing issues, overdue invoices, insurance questions, or benefit plans. Mars with Mercury favors asking direct questions and simplifying tangled arrangements. Instead of trying to fix everything at once, choose one knot to untangle today, such as clarifying a subscription, fee structure, or repayment schedule.

🧘 Advice: Don’t shy away from the heavy conversations—but prepare for them. A few minutes of reflection beforehand can turn confrontation into constructive change.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: You protect your peace not by avoiding depth, but by defining clearly how you’re willing to share it.
cancer:

The 5th-house Scorpio Sun deepens romantic intensity and a desire for genuine emotional contact. If single, today’s energy favors noticing who consistently shows up with care rather than who flares up with occasional drama. Encounters connected to work or service contexts can be meaningful.

💰 Money: The 6th-house activation highlights links between your daily habits and your income: how your time, energy and health affect your earning power. The 7th-house Moon may draw your attention to shared expenses, agreements with clients, or decisions that must be made jointly. This is a solid day for renegotiating practical terms in a calm, grounded way. Small, routine-oriented financial shifts—like automating a modest savings transfer or restructuring how bills are managed between partners—are better supported than big leaps.

🧘 Advice: Balance care with clarity. Being emotionally attuned doesn’t mean taking on more than your share—especially when others are willing to step up if you let them.

leo:
♌ Leo

The Scorpio Sun in the 4th suggests that behind many work decisions lies a question about stability, home, or emotional security. Meanwhile, Mercury-Mars in the 5th boost your charisma and appetite for visible projects or leadership roles. You’re well-placed to pitch an idea or take the lead on a presentation, provided you’ve handled the underlying details and deadlines first.

❤️ Love: Scorpio’s influence on your 4th house makes you more aware of how safe, understood and rooted you feel in your closest relationships. The Moon in the 6th highlights the everyday side of love: how you share chores, errands, emotional labor. Mercury-Mars in your 5th raise the volume on flirting, romantic spontaneity and creative dates. If partnered, consider mixing a practical task with something fun—reorganizing a space together then celebrating with a playful evening. If single, you may encounter someone through a hobby, performance, or while helping out in a small way; genuine enthusiasm will matter more than grand displays.

Choose one or two splurges that truly add color to your life, and offset them by tightening up in an area that doesn’t matter as much.

🧘 Advice: Aim for sustainable brilliance. It’s better to shine in a few chosen areas with solid support underneath than try to dazzle everywhere at once.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your light feels strongest to others when it’s grounded in a life that actually works for you behind the scenes.

libra:

scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

The Capricorn Moon in the 3rd supports structured thinking, drafting documents, planning schedules or mapping out a project step-by-step. Mercury-Mars in your 2nd fuel motivation around earnings, pricing and financial independence. This is an excellent day to review your professional narrative—CV, portfolio, or how you describe your work—and adjust it so it reflects your current strengths and direction.

The 3rd-house Moon encourages straightforward, even if slightly reserved, conversations. Mercury-Mars in the 2nd bring a desire to feel valued not just emotionally, but also in how time, effort and tangible gestures are exchanged. If partnered, you might talk about practical expressions of care—how you support each other’s goals, finances or daily life. 🧘 Advice: Allow yourself to update your self-image as honestly as you update your plans. The more accurately you see yourself, the more precisely you can move.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating your power as something to hide or prove, it becomes something you can calmly direct.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Capricorn highlights your 2nd house of resources, priorities and self-worth today, Sagittarius. You’re naturally future-focused, but this placement asks: what are you actually standing on? Jupiter, your ruler, continues in Leo in your 9th house, still supporting growth through vision, learning and principled risks. The Sun has moved into Scorpio in your 12th, beginning a quieter, more inward solar month. Mercury and Mars in your own sign keep your outer energy high even as something deeper seeks privacy and rest.

💼 Career: Outwardly you may seem driven and proactive with Mercury-Mars in Sagittarius, but the Scorpio Sun in your 12th hints that some of your most important work is happening behind the scenes: planning, healing, or letting go of past cycles. The Capricorn Moon in your 2nd encourages practical attention to salary, fees, or how your skills are currently monetized. Use your assertiveness to advocate for fair compensation or to initiate a small, concrete step toward a more authentic career direction—such as setting a timeline for a move, sabbatical, or new project—without broadcasting everything yet.

❤️ Love: You might feel a subtle pull inward emotionally, even if you’re socially active. The 12th-house Sun can bring up private feelings, old memories or dreams about relationships. The Moon in the 2nd asks whether your connections genuinely support your sense of worth, not just your sense of adventure. If partnered, quieter shared time—walks, simple meals, honest check-ins about security—can feel more nourishing than big outings. If single, attraction may stir with someone who appreciates your ideals but also respects your need for solitude; trust the pace that feels natural rather than the one that looks exciting.

💰 Money: Today is well-suited for straightforward financial housekeeping. The 2nd-house Moon encourages you to look at what actually comes in and goes out, and how aligned it is with your real priorities. Jupiter in the 9th still favors investments in education, travel or spiritual growth, but the Scorpio Sun suggests starting with subtle shifts—like redirecting a small recurring expense into a fund for a future trip or course. Mars in your 1st can trigger impulsive buys; pause and ask whether a purchase truly supports where you’re headed.

🧘 Advice: Let your enthusiasm run through a quieter filter for a while. When your inner and outer aims line up, you won’t have to push so hard.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The opportunity that matters most now may be the space you give yourself to reset your direction from the inside out.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

At the same time, Mercury and Mars in the 12th suggest that some frustrations or ambitions are not yet ready for public view; you might be working on a behind-the-scenes exit strategy, restructuring idea or creative side project. Meanwhile, Mercury-Mars in the 12th may surface old romantic memories or private grievances. If partnered, gently name where you feel over-responsible, and invite more shared decision-making. With the Sun in your 11th, consider how your income and spending relate to longer-term aspirations—retirement, community projects, collaborations. Mars and Mercury in the 12th can indicate hidden costs, subscriptions, or draining obligations that need review. Cancelling one quiet leak or setting a discreet boundary around lending or favors can strengthen your position over time.

🧘 Advice: Honor your current limits without judging them. Strength for you today includes the willingness to move one realistic step at a time.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating endurance as your only option, you open space for choices that are quietly kinder to you.
aquarius:
